title: Schedule of Perils Answered For under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
Each plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans answers for the perils listed for it below and for no other; a peril listed as excluded is never answered for. The same schedule sets, per plan, the days the customer has to give their account of a loss and whether a police report reference must be recorded before a theft claim is settled.

## Perils by plan

| | Manufacturer Limited Warranty | Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Perils answered for | manufacturing defect | manufacturing defect, prong wear, chain break, clasp failure | manufacturing defect, prong wear, chain break, clasp failure, stone loss | manufacturing defect, prong wear, chain break, clasp failure, stone loss, water damage | manufacturing defect, prong wear, chain break, clasp failure, stone loss, water damage, theft | manufacturing defect, prong wear, chain break, clasp failure, stone loss, water damage, theft, mysterious disappearance |
| Perils excluded | prong wear, chain break, clasp failure, stone loss, water damage, theft, mysterious disappearance, intentional damage | stone loss, water damage, theft, mysterious disappearance, intentional damage | water damage, theft, mysterious disappearance, intentional damage | theft, mysterious disappearance, intentional damage | mysterious disappearance, intentional damage | intentional damage |
| A stone lost from its setting is covered | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| A piece that simply cannot be found is covered | no | no | no | no | no | yes |
| Theft of the covered piece is covered | no | no | no | no | yes | yes |
| Police report reference required before a theft claim is settled | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Proof-of-loss window, calendar days from the loss | 30 | 30 | 45 | 45 | 60 | 90 |

## Questions the schedule answers

**Is intentional damage ever answered for?** No plan in the family lists it among the perils answered for, and every plan lists it as excluded.

**Which plans answer for a stone lost from its setting?** The Belrose Care Plan 3-Year, the Belrose Care Plan 5-Year, the Belrose Lifetime Care Plan and the Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan; the Manufacturer Limited Warranty and the Belrose Care Plan 2-Year do not.

**Does a police report requirement fall away on a plan that does not cover theft?** The requirement is set to yes on every plan; on a plan that does not answer for theft at all, a theft claim is not answered for in the first place, and the report requirement bears only on the plans that do cover it, the Belrose Lifetime Care Plan and the Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan.

**How long does the customer have to give their account of the loss?** The number of calendar days shown for the plan, counted from the loss: 30 on the Manufacturer Limited Warranty and the Belrose Care Plan 2-Year, 45 on the 3-Year and 5-Year plans, 60 on the Belrose Lifetime Care Plan and 90 on the Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan.
